units.source_text: 本书体例分上下两卷，用美浓纸印刷，

en.t: This book is arranged in two volumes, upper and lower, and is printed on Mino paper,

units.source_text: 采用草体汉字与平假名文字，印刷的不是很鲜明，

en.t: using cursive-style Chinese characters and hiragana, and the printing is not very sharp,
nor is it clear whether it was printed with movable type.

units.source_text: 上卷扉页，印刷横行拉丁文，下行印刷汉字“千五百九十六年，庆长二年三月上旬镂刻也”，作二直行。

en.t: On the title page of the upper volume, Latin script is printed horizontally, and below it the Chinese characters "carved in early March of Keicho 2, 1596" are printed in two vertical columns.

units.source_text: 纪年二侧配有吹唢呐天使的画像，技术一般，不过印刷的很清楚。

en.t: On both sides of the date are portraits of angels blowing shawms; the technique is ordinary, but the printing is very clear.

units.source_text: 下卷扉页，除了多了“五月接刻也”一语，其他与上卷没差别。

en.t: The title page of the lower volume differs from that of the upper volume only by the added phrase "continued carving in May."
